title: 第11章 你想当魔王不想第12章 勇者协会
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
听到林默已经升到10级了，殷血悬浮在半空。
她的嘴巴微张，表情震惊到几乎变形。
“你确定是一晚上升到10级？不是我睡了好几天？”
她甚至怀疑是不是自己灵魂受损导致感知时间错乱了。
林默只是耸了耸肩，用沉默代替了回答。
那眼神仿佛在说这有什么好大惊小怪的。
殷血连忙仔细感受了一下通过灵魂连接传递来的波动。
又对比了一下自己比昨天更强了几分的力量。
终于不得不确认了这个离谱的事实。
眼前这个家伙。
真的只用了一晚上，就达到了普通人可能需要数月甚至数年才能达到的10级！
她再次震惊地呆立在半空，小小的脑袋里充满了大大的问号和惊叹号。
这时，林默走了过来坐在床边。
问出了心中的疑惑：“不过我升到10级之后，就不能再获得经验了，是怎么回事？”
这才是他回来的主要目的。
殷血这才猛地闭上一直微张的小嘴巴。
艰难地咽了口唾沫，努力平复翻江倒海的心情。
这才解释道：“因为在这个世界，每提升10级，就是一个坎。想要跨过去，必须吸收一个兽王级别的魔物死后凝聚的精魄才能继续升级。”
听了殷血的话林默反而更疑惑了。
“你是说风狼王死了之后，它嘴里那颗发光的牙齿吧？我已经吸收了啊。”

说着，他还意念微动。
在身旁召唤出了另一个与他一般无二的林默。
正是【镜像】技能的效果。
殷血的眼睛瞬间瞪得比刚才还圆，眼珠子都快掉出来了。
声音都变了调：“风狼王？！你是说你一晚上时间不仅升到了10级，还顺带宰了一只兽王？！而且还成功吸收了它的技能精髓？！”
林默点了点头，一脸这不是很正常吗的表情。
殷血看着那个缓缓消散的分身，嘴角不受控制地抽搐起来。
她回想起漫长岁月里见过的形形色色的人类。
无论是天赋异禀的勇者。
还是经验老道的冒险家。
甚至一些惊才绝艳的英雄人物。
都没有一个这么离谱的啊！
这家伙不是昨天才被召唤来的吗？
满打满算不到十二个小时！
半天时间，升10级，单杀一只兽王？！
要知道，每一只能被冠以兽王之名的魔物，其实力都远超同阶。
通常都需要最少五个同等级，且配合默契的冒险家组队。
才有机会狩猎成功。
这家伙……这家伙到底是怎么办到的？
林默自然不知道殷血在想些什么，依旧沉浸在自己的逻辑里。
content_en:
Hearing that Lin Mo had reached level 10, Yin Xue was suspended in the air.
Her mouth was slightly open, and her expression was so shocked that she was almost deformed.
"Are you sure you reached level 10 in one night? Didn't I sleep for several days?"
She even wondered if her soul was damaged, causing her perception of time to be distorted.
Lin Mo just shrugged and replaced his answer with silence.
The look in his eyes seemed to say what's all the fuss about.
Yin Xue quickly felt carefully the fluctuations transmitted through the soul connection.
Then he compared how much stronger he was than yesterday.
Finally, I had to confirm this outrageous fact.
This guy in front of me.
It really only took one night to reach level 10, which may take ordinary people months or even years to reach!
She stood in mid-air in shock again, her little head filled with big question marks and exclamation marks.
At this time, Lin Mo came over and sat beside the bed.
He asked the doubt in his mind: "But after I reach level 10, I can no longer gain experience. What's going on?"
This is the main purpose of his return.
Yin Xue suddenly closed his slightly open mouth.
He swallowed hard and tried to calm down his overwhelming mood.
Then he explained: "Because in this world, every 10 levels is a hurdle. If you want to cross it, you must absorb the essence condensed after the death of a beast king-level monster before you can continue to level up."
After hearing Yin Xue's words, Lin Mo became even more confused.
"You mean the glowing teeth in the Wind Wolf King's mouth after it died, right? I have already absorbed it."
As he spoke, his thoughts moved slightly.
Another Lin Mo who was just like him was summoned beside him.
It is exactly the effect of the [Mirror Image] skill.
Yin Xue's eyes suddenly became even wider than before, and his eyeballs almost fell out.
The tone of his voice changed: "Wind Wolf King?! Are you telling me that you not only reached level 10 in one night, but also killed a beast king?! And you also successfully absorbed the essence of its skills?!"
Lin Mo nodded, with an expression on his face that said, "Isn't this normal?"
Yin Xue looked at the clone that slowly dissipated, and the corners of his mouth twitched uncontrollably.
She recalled the various human beings she had seen over the long years.
No matter he is a brave person with extraordinary talents.
He is also an experienced adventurer.
Even some amazingly talented heroes.
None of them are so outrageous!
Wasn't this guy just summoned yesterday?
It takes less than twelve hours to complete the game!
In half a day, you can level up to 10 levels and kill a beast king alone? !
You must know that every monster that can only be named the Beast King is far more powerful than the same level.
Usually a team of at least five adventurers of the same level and with good cooperation is required.
Only then can you have a chance to hunt successfully.
This guy...how on earth did this guy do it?
Lin Mo naturally didn't know what Yin Xue was thinking, and was still immersed in his own logic.
